READY.REQUIRED_FIELD.description: A field this policy needs before any advice is missing.

READY.HORIZON_VS_RISK.description: The shortest goal horizon is below the minimum for the client's effective risk level.

DATA.PROFILE_STALE.description: The client profile is older than the policy allows, or its as-of date is unknown.

DATA.PRODUCTS_STALE.description: Product data in the pack is older than the policy allows, or its as-of date is unknown.

DATA.MARKET_STALE.description: Market data in the pack is older than the policy allows, or its as-of date is unknown.

ALLOC.MISSING.description: The pack has no allocation to check.

ALLOC.UNKNOWN_CLASS.description: An allocation row names an asset class outside the taxonomy.

ALLOC.SUM.description: The new TAA does not sum to 100%.

ALLOC.BAND.description: A new TAA weight is outside its SAA band.

ALLOC.GROWTH_CEILING.description: The new TAA's growth-asset share is above the ceiling for the client's risk level and horizon.

ALLOC.NOT_PREFERRED.description: The new TAA puts weight in an asset class outside the client's preferred classes.

PROD.UNVERIFIED.description: A recommended product cannot be found on the product shelf, so it cannot be checked.

PROD.SUITABILITY.description: A recommended product fails the shared suitability gate.

PROD.CLASS_NOT_ALLOCATED.description: A recommended product's asset class has no weight in the new TAA.

PROD.WEIGHTS_MISSING.description: Product weights were not supplied, so single-product and currency caps cannot be checked.

PROD.SINGLE_CAP.description: One product's weight is above the single-product cap.

PROD.FX_CAP.description: Unhedged foreign-currency products exceed the currency exposure cap.

PACK.SECTION_INCOMPLETE.description: A pack section is not marked complete or has no text.

PACK.SECTION_FLAGGED.description: A pack section is flagged for attention.

PACK.PRIOR_GATE.description: An earlier gate has not been approved.

TEXT.CLAIM.description: Pack text makes a guarantee, risk-free, certainty, optimality, live-data or execution claim.

TEXT.DISCLAIMER.description: No section carries a required disclaimer.

TEXT.NUMBERS.description: Pack text states a figure that does not match any checked figure.
